title: 第3章 梅开二度
slug: 从素晴开始成为海贼王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

海贼世界，东海的某座荒岛上。

林北蹲在篝火前，抱着膝盖，眼眶微微发红。

“太讨厌了！素晴世界太讨厌了！”

这一刻，他居然有种劫后余生般的庆幸。

他深吸一口气，整理好情绪，看着手指上的戒指发了会儿呆。

如果不回去，以他现在的实力，充其量在海贼世界当一辈子杂鱼。

可如果回去，总感觉会有更不妙的事情等着他。

他咬咬牙，将意识沉入传送戒指，锁定素晴世界里目前唯一的传送坐标。

——达克尼斯所在旅馆的浴室。

“这个时间，她差不多应该睡熟了吧？趁这个机会，偷偷溜走好了。”

“一切为了变强！拼了！”

同一时间，河边旅馆，达克尼斯的房间。

经历刚才那件事后，达克尼斯发现自己失眠了，躺在床上翻来覆去闹出了不小的动静。

就连住在隔壁的克里斯都被吵醒了。

克里斯是她的冒险者伙伴，也是她唯一的朋友。

那是一名身材娇小的白发盗贼，和达克尼斯丰满傲人的曲线相比，简直像个还没发育的孩子。

在这个人才辈出的阿克塞尔，克里斯算是为数不多的脑袋正常的女孩儿。

当然，达克尼斯并不知道，克里斯还有另一层身份。

负责素晴世界的女神——幸运女神厄里斯的人间体。

在克里斯的追问下，达克尼斯吞吞吐吐地把刚才发生的一切都说了出来。

“什么？！居然有这种事？”

克里斯握紧拳头，义愤填膺地保证：“我一定会帮你抓住这个卑鄙无耻的淫贼！”

达克尼斯却有些犹豫。

不知道为什么，她内心似乎并不希望那个会夜袭她的男人被抓。

两人在房间里聊了一夜，等天边泛起微光时，疲惫感终于袭来。

克里斯揉了揉眼睛，打算先洗个澡，然后好好补一觉，等下午再和达克尼斯继续冒险者活动。

就在她拿起换洗衣服走向浴室时，脚步莫名顿住了，心头掠过一阵说不清缘由的不安。

“……还是算了吧。”

她说服自己只是太累，然后转身直接倒在达克尼斯的床上睡了过去。

达克尼斯在给克里斯盖好被子后，拖着疲惫的身子走进浴室。

热水缓缓漫过肩头，紧绷了一整晚的神经终于松弛下来。

她靠在浴缸边缘，长出一口气，久违的宁静让人昏昏欲睡。

就在她合上眼的刹那。

一片白光毫无预兆地在浴缸正上方炸开。

正是传送回来的林北。

“——哎？”

水花四溅，熟悉的触感再度传来……

“为什么？为什么你还在浴室洗澡？都快清晨了，你不睡觉的吗？”

“为什么？为什么你又出现在这里？都快清晨了，你不睡觉的吗？”

话音同时落下，两人僵在氤氲的水汽里，面面相觑。

短暂的沉默后……

Page (1/3)

Pirate World, a desert island in the East China Sea.

Lin Bei squatted in front of the bonfire, hugging his knees, his eyes slightly red.

"It's so annoying! Suqing's world is so annoying!"

At this moment, he actually felt as lucky as after a disaster.

He took a deep breath, gathered his emotions, and stared at the ring on his finger in a daze for a while.

If he doesn't go back, with his current strength, he will at best be a bastard in the pirate world for the rest of his life.

But if he goes back, he always feels like there will be something worse waiting for him.

He gritted his teeth, sinking his consciousness into the teleportation ring, and locked onto the only teleportation coordinates in Suqing's world.

——The bathroom of the hotel where Darkness is located.

"She should be almost asleep at this time, right? Take this opportunity to sneak away."

"Everything is to become stronger! Work hard!"

At the same time, Darkness's room at the riverside hotel.

After experiencing the incident just now, Darkness found that she had insomnia and was lying on the bed tossing and turning, making a lot of noise.

Even Chris, who lives next door, was woken up.

Chris is her fellow adventurer and her only friend.

It was a petite white-haired thief who looked like an undeveloped child compared to Darkness' plump and proud curves.

In this Axel world full of talents, Chris is one of the few girls with a normal head.

Of course, Darkness doesn't know that Chris has another identity.

The human body of Eris, the goddess of luck, the goddess in charge of the world of Suqing.

Under Chris's questioning, Darkness hesitantly told everything that had just happened.

"What?! Such a thing is happening?"

Chris clenched his fists and promised indignantly: "I will definitely help you catch this despicable and shameless thief!"

Darkness was hesitant.

For some reason, she didn't seem to want the man who attacked her at night to be caught.

The two of them chatted in the room all night, and when there was a faint light on the horizon, they finally felt tired.

Chris rubbed his eyes, planning to take a bath first, then get a good night's sleep, and then continue adventure activities with Darkness in the afternoon.

Just as she picked up a change of clothes and walked to the bathroom, her steps paused inexplicably, and a wave of unexplainable uneasiness passed through her heart.

"...Let's forget it."

She convinced herself that she was just too tired, then turned around and fell directly onto Darkness' bed and fell asleep.

After covering Chris with a quilt, Darkness dragged her tired body into the bathroom.

The hot water slowly spread over my shoulders, and the nerves that had been tense all night finally relaxed.

She leaned on the edge of the bathtub and let out a long breath, the long-lost tranquility making her drowsy.

The moment she closed her eyes.

A white light exploded directly above the bathtub without warning.

It was Lin Bei who was teleported back.

"——Huh?"

Water splashed everywhere, and the familiar touch came again...

"Why? Why are you still taking a shower in the bathroom? It's almost early morning, aren't you going to sleep?"

"Why? Why are you here again? It's almost early morning, aren't you sleeping?"

The words fell at the same time, and the two of them were frozen in the mist, looking at each other.

After a short silence...
